zh.title: 阿提哈德航空最後一架封存A380重返阿布達比
zh.summary: 阿提哈德航空最後一架封存A380返回阿布達比
body: 阿提哈德航空（Etihad Airways）在COVID-19疫情期間封存的最後一架空中巴士A380，正返回阿布達比。這架飛機在法國南部存放超過五年後，於2026年9月17日上午9時30分後從塔布-盧爾德-比利牛斯機場（LDE）起飛，前往阿布達比扎耶德國際機場（AUH）。
根據Flightradar24的資料，這架註冊編號為A6-APB的A380-800，過去八個月由飛機專業公司TARMAC Aerosave進行飛行準備。A6-APB於2015年交付給阿提哈德航空，但在2020年停飛，並於2020年12月飛往塔爾布。
一旦A380安全降落阿布達比，它將進行進一步的重度維修，以確保飛機能投入商業運營。當A6-APB恢復運營後，阿提哈德航空的九架A380都將恢復機隊運作。
根據Planespotter.net的資料，註冊編號A6-APC的A380已於2026年6月5日返回服務，該機於2026年1月抵達阿布達比。阿提哈德航空於2023年3月讓第一架封存的A380（A6-APG）回歸，第二架A6-API則於2023年5月離開封存地點。
第三架雙層客機A6-APH於2023年6月21日從塔爾布-盧爾德-比利牛斯機場的存放地點起飛。第十架A380（註冊編號A6-APA）則於2025年報廢。
2020年8月曾有消息指出，阿提哈德航空計劃於2026年6月與2027年1月使最後兩架A380重返服務。在COVID-19疫情導致全球旅行停擺時，阿提哈德航空封存了全部十架A380。

en.title: Final Etihad Airbus A380 stored during pandemic heads back to Abu Dhabi
en.summary: Etihad's final stored A380 returns to Abu Dhabi after over five years
body: The final Etihad Airways Airbus A380 stored during the COVID-19 pandemic is returning to Abu Dhabi after spending over five years in storage in southern France. On September 17, 2026, shortly after 09:30 local time, the aircraft departed Tarbes-Lourdes-Pyrenees Airport (LDE) for Abu Dhabi Zayed International Airport (AUH) in the UAE.

According to Flightradar24, the Etihad A380-800, registered A6-APB, has spent the last eight months being prepared for flight with aircraft specialists TARMAC Aerosave. Once the A380 lands safely in Abu Dhabi, it will go through further heavy maintenance to ensure the aircraft is ready for commercial operations.

A6-APB was delivered to Etihad in 2015 but was withdrawn from operations in 2020 and flown to Tarbes in December 2020. In August 2025, news broke that Etihad planned to return its last two A380s to service in June 2026 and January 2027.

According to Planespotter.net, the Etihad A380, registered A6-APC, returned to service on June 5, 2026, after arriving back in Abu Dhabi in January 2026. Etihad brought back its first stored A380, registered A6-APG, in March 2023, while the second A380, registered A6-API, left storage in May 2023.

Its third double-decker aircraft, registered 6-APH, departed its storage location at Tarbes-Lourdes-Pyrenees Airport on June 21, 2023. Once A6-APB recommences operations, all nine Etihad Airbus A380s will be fleet active. A tenth A380, registered A6-APA, was scrapped in 2025.

When the COVID-19 pandemic grounded global travel, Etihad stored all 10 A380s. While initially there were no plans for the superjumbos to return to service, following the pandemic there was a huge appetite for long-haul travel.

zh.title: 利雅德航空開通利雅德直飛曼徹斯特航線
zh.summary: 利雅德航空首航利雅德往返曼徹斯特；每週三班
body: 利雅德航空（Riyadh Air）已營運首班自沙烏地阿拉伯首都利雅德哈立德國王國際機場（RUH）直飛英格蘭曼徹斯特（MAN）的不經停航班。
這條新航線於2026年9月17日開通，將以波音787-9（ICAO機型代碼B789）執飛，每週三班，分別於星期二、星期四及星期六營運。
該機型配置290個座位，包括28個商務艙座位（其中4個為「商務精英」座位）、39個豪華經濟艙座位及223個經濟艙座位。
曼徹斯特成為該航空繼2026年6月開通與倫敦希斯洛（LHR）的定期商業服務後，在英國的第二個目的地。

en.title: Riyadh Air launches nonstop service between Saudi capital and Manchester
en.summary: Riyadh Air begins nonstop Riyadh-Manchester flights; thrice-weekly
body: Riyadh Air has operated its first nonstop flight between King Khalid International Airport (RUH) in the Saudi capital and Manchester (MAN), England.

The new route, launched on September 17, 2026, will see thrice-weekly service on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays, operated by Boeing 787-9 aircraft fitted with 290 seats in a three-class configuration (28 in business, including four designated as 'Business Elite' seats, 39 in premium economy and 223 in economy).

Manchester has become the second destination in the United Kingdom to be served by the airline, following the launch of regular commercial services between Riyadh and London-Heathrow (LHR) in June 2026.

zh.title: 德國將派4架颱風戰機赴拉脫維亞護航大選空域
zh.summary: 德國將派4架颱風戰機赴拉脫維亞協助保護大選期間空域
body: 據AeroTime報導，德國將於2026年9月底至10月初部署4架颱風戰機至拉脫維亞中部的列爾瓦德空軍基地，為該國10月3日的國會大選提供空域保護。
德國聯邦國防部表示，拉脫維亞政府請求盟友提供防空支援，確保大選能安全舉行，原因是近期數週或數月波羅的海國家發生多次無人機入侵事件。
國防部表示：「面對東翼尤其暴露的盟友，德國可靠地站在他們的一邊。」
根據報導，這批戰機來自駐多瑙河畔諾伊布爾格的德國空軍第74戰術聯隊；國防部未透露具體到達或離開日期。

en.title: Germany to Deploy Four Eurofighters to Latvia for Airspace Protection During Election
en.summary: Germany will deploy four Eurofighters to Latvia for about a week around the October 3 election.
body: Germany will deploy four Eurofighter jets to Lielvārde Air Base in central Latvia for about a week from late September to early October 2026, to help protect Latvian airspace during the country's parliamentary election on October 3, 2026, AeroTime reported.

According to the German Federal Ministry of Defense, the Latvian government asked allies for air defense support to ensure the election could be held safely, citing repeated drone violations of airspace over the Baltic states in recent weeks and months.
The ministry said, 'Germany stands reliably by the side of its allies that are particularly exposed on the eastern flank.'

The aircraft will come from Tactical Air Wing 74 based in Neuburg an der Donau. The ministry described the detachment as small, numbering in the mid-double digits, but did not give exact arrival or departure dates.
